Update Aug.15.25 - glad to see my fav dentist Dr. Angkana again - took her time to do a thorough cleaning for me & explain issues, help me do a better job with my dental care & got great tip to help improve my enamel! So glad I got to see her today!

Update - came in for a 4th time in about 2 years, on 3/21/25, for a cleaning with Dr. Angkana again (my fav!).  Really appreciate that she took the time to show me how to clean with a dental pick at the gum line to prevent further rescission.  Look forward to coming back again in the fall.

Updated 07/22/24 - came in today for a filling and cleaning and Dr. Angkana is still so thorough and careful! I really appreciate being able to see her 3x now. Reasonable prices, nice staff who can certainly speak English, and easy to make appointments etc. via calling or messaging them in Line app.  It was convenient to again use contactless Apple Pay :)

Update 12/29/23 - came back for another cleaning with Dr. Angkana. She was awesome again, gentle but thorough, and gave me good tips to keep my teeth clean after we were done. I drink coffee and tea every day(stains) so it’s good to see her to get a cleaning two or three times a year!

Loving it - just had a gentle but thorough dental cleaning this morning with Dr. Angkana - she was awesome, took really good care of me and I made an appointment to see her again next Friday to do two bondings (minor preventive fillings that don’t require numbing injection) - my dentist back home had done these over a year ago and they typically fall off after a year or so, and I knew they had fallen off but had been lazy to go get them redone:)

Everyone at All Dent is friendly and professional. They are transparent with what they do, how much it costs, and take the time to explain any issues or questions you have.

I came here initially because an acquaintance from Belgium likes their dental work. Now, I’m recommending a friend to come and he’ll go for a cleaning too in the coming days!

This is my spot now for dental care I’m Bangkok!  Keep up the great work!

I was on my last day in Bangkok and urgently needed a dental procedure. I found All Dent through Google Maps and was encouraged by the positive reviews. I walked in without an appointment, and to my relief, the dentist was available. Within 15 minutes, I was already in the chair. She was kind, gentle, and spoke very good English. She clearly explained the treatment I needed and got to work right away.

She managed to fix two of my back molars—teeth that two dentists in Europe had refused to touch, saying they were too hard to reach. I'm so glad I found her. She not only saved my teeth but did it with care and skill. The pricing was very reasonable, and the quality of the work was excellent. I highly recommend this clinic if you're in Bangkok and need dental work done.

I had a great experience with All Dent dental clinic! I was able to get an appointment on the next day for a semi-annual cleaning. The doctor did a great job and she made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the procedure. The team is very responsive and helpful.
Got a nice teeth cleaning for 1000 Baht. Employees were friendly, helpful, and spoke good English. On time and efficient too!

Very bad experience, they made me two fillings, one of them, after 15 days with pain and chills, I returned and they gave me a paste to calm down for 3 hours, then I returned to the same, I do not recommend this clinic.
Great place for dental care and Dr. is very nice with professional great job.
Will not recommend if you want to keep your teeth well maintained.
You can make reservation by phone. Affordable price. Accept social security card insurance.

Amazing clinic and doctor!
We've been all over Bangkok looking for a simple procedure – to tighten the archwire on my braces.
Everywhere we go, the answer is: no, we can't, there's no orthodontist, we don't know, we don't know how.
But here they said: no problem!
And they only charged 200 baht.
Great people, thank you!

I had seven teeth filled.
Dr. Noey was very gentle. It only took an hour to complete all the fillings, and now I can chew food well.
